scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server:dev" "npm run client"
scripts.server:check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-ChildItem -Path server -Recurse -Include *.js -Exclude package.json | ForEach-Object { & node --check $_.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'FAIL:' $_.FullName; exit 1 } }; Write-Host 'All server files passed syntax check'"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.health: node -e "const http = require('http'); const port = process.env.PORT || 5000; http.get('http://localhost:' + port + '/healthz', r => { console.log('HTTP', r.statusCode); process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1) }).on('error', e => { console.error('FAIL:', e.message); process.exit(2) })"
scripts.lint: echo 'No ESLint configured yet - skipping lint'
scripts.format: echo 'No Prettier configured yet - skipping format'
